tagline: Designer and distributor of innovative outdoor products for outdoor enthusiasts and adventure seekers
hero_kpi_rationale: Drinkware segment revenue represents 58% of YETI's total net sales in 2025, making it a key driver of the company's growth

kpis.name: Drinkware Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of drinkware products such as bottles, jugs, mugs, and tumblers.
kpis.description: The Drinkware segment represents 58% of YETI's total net sales in 2025, generating approximately $1,084 million.

kpis.name: Coolers Equipment Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of coolers equipment products including hard coolers, soft cooler bags, everyday bags, travel bags, pursuit bags, cargo and storage, and outdoor living.
kpis.description: The Coolers Equipment segment represents 40% of YETI's total net sales in 2025, generating approximately $747 million.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross profit margin representing the percentage of net sales remaining after cost of goods sold, indicating operational efficiency and pricing power.
kpis.description: YETI's consolidated gross margin for fiscal year 2025 is 57.4%, slightly down from 58% in 2024, reflecting the impact of tariffs and supply chain disruptions.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total net sales from all product categories and channels including wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels.
kpis.description: YETI's total net sales for fiscal year 2025 amount to $1,868.5 million, up 2.1% compared to 2024, despite a challenging macroeconomic environment.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating income calculated as gross profit minus selling, general, and administrative expenses, reflecting core operational profitability.
kpis.description: YETI's operating income for fiscal year 2025 is $213.6 million, representing 11% of net sales.

risks.title: Brand reputation and loss of demand
risks.score_rationale: The YETI name and premium brand image are integral to business growth. A significant reduction in brand value or customer demand could materially harm operating results and revenue growth.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: Competitive pressures are mentioned as an important risk affecting market share and pricing power. YETI must differentiate to maintain market position.

risks.title: Tariff and trade policy impacts
risks.score_rationale: U.S. tariffs on imports from key manufacturing countries increased production costs in 2025, creating supply chain disruptions and inventory constraints that adversely impacted sales.

risks.title: Growth management challenges
risks.score_rationale: Managing rapid growth while maintaining product quality, brand integrity, and operational efficiency presents ongoing challenges for the organization.

risks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and consumer spending
risks.score_rationale: YETI experienced a challenging macroeconomic and consumer spending environment in 2025 that adversely impacted operating results. Future impacts in 2026 remain uncertain.

risks.title: Loss of key personnel
risks.score_rationale: Loss of key management could impair the company's ability to execute strategy and manage growth effectively.

risks.title: Intellectual property risks
risks.score_rationale: Protection of intellectual property rights is necessary to maintain competitive advantage and product differentiation in the outdoor products market.

ai_positioning.summary: YETI does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
